resources.string: Shows your soundbar\'s volume on screen when the TV doesn\'t.
Ready. Press volume up or down on your remote.
One step left: Volume Bar needs permission to show over other apps.
This TV has no permission screen. Press \"Set up automatically\".
Setting up… If the TV asks \"Allow debugging?\", tick \"Always allow\" and press OK.
Done! Press volume up or down on your remote.

Turn on debugging first, then press \"Set up automatically\" again:\n1. Settings › Device Preferences › About: press \"Build\" 7 times.\n2. Settings › Device Preferences › Developer options: turn on \"USB debugging\" (and \"Network debugging\" if you see it).
The TV didn\'t allow it. Press \"Set up automatically\" again and choose OK on the TV.
Setup didn\'t work on this TV: %1$s
